Name: HoneyBadger and Bees
Author: HoneyBadger and Bees
Description: Live status of the HoneyBadger and Bees YouTube pipeline and channel, plus recording, prompter and approval keys.

Actions.Name: Review queue
Actions.Tooltip: Episodes waiting in 2 Review. Press: open the folder

Actions.Name: Pipeline now
Actions.Tooltip: What the autopilot is doing. Press: open the log

Actions.Name: Runway
Actions.Tooltip: Weeks of episodes already scheduled. Press: open 4 Scheduled

Actions.Name: Next episode
Actions.Tooltip: Next episode going live. Press: open it in YouTube Studio

Actions.Name: New comments
Actions.Tooltip: New YouTube comments since the last press. Press: open Studio comments (nothing is posted)

Actions.Name: Channel pulse
Actions.Tooltip: Subscribers and views of the newest live episode. Press: open analytics

Actions.Name: HBB recording mode
Actions.Tooltip: Opens Elgato Studio (camera + prompter) and runs a session timer. Press again to stop

Actions.Name: HBB prompter
Actions.Tooltip: Opens Elgato Studio on the next HBB script to record (only the script changes)

Actions.Name: Quick review
Actions.Tooltip: Plays the newest episode in 2 Review in QuickTime

Actions.Name: LinkedIn post
Actions.Tooltip: Next LinkedIn launch post and when it goes. Press: open its LINKEDIN.txt

Actions.Name: Thumbnail
Actions.Tooltip: Thumbnail of the episode in review. Press: open it (or its prompt if still to make)

Actions.Name: Approve all
Actions.Tooltip: Press twice: everything ready in 2 Review goes to 3 Approved (video, thumbnail, LinkedIn post, Shorts)

Actions.Name: Studio links
Actions.Tooltip: Cards and end screens still to add in YouTube Studio. Press: open the next one

Actions.Name: Friday auto-approve
Actions.Tooltip: Which episode the Friday 18:00 auto-approve will take. Press: open it
